features.title: Built for the way hauliers actually work
features.subtitle: Replace the spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and paper PODs with one system your office and drivers both love.

jobs.title: Jobs & instant quotes
jobs.body: Book a job in seconds. Route distance and your rates produce a price automatically — with fuel and ADR surcharges.

dispatch.title: Drag-and-drop dispatch
dispatch.body: Plan the day on a visual board. Drag jobs onto drivers and vehicles and everyone is updated instantly.

tracking.title: Live GPS tracking
tracking.body: See every vehicle on a live map with real-time status — no extra trackers or hardware to install.

driver.title: Driver app with POD
driver.body: Drivers see their run, navigate, and capture signatures and photos as proof of delivery on any phone.

invoicing.title: VAT-correct invoicing & e-invoicing
invoicing.body: UK VAT, EU VAT and reverse charge, plus VAT for Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain and Oman, with Saudi ZATCA e-invoicing (Phase 2) built in.

cmr.title: Digital CMR notes
cmr.body: Generate CMR consignment notes for international loads as PDFs, pre-filled from the job.

compliance.title: Compliance & checks
compliance.body: Daily walkaround checks, MOT, insurance, tacho and licence expiry reminders before they become fines.

links.title: Customer tracking links
links.body: Send a branded link so your customers can follow their delivery and see the POD — fewer “where is it?” calls.

gdpr.title: GDPR & UK hosting
gdpr.body: Your data lives in London with encryption, row-level isolation, audit logs and one-click data export.

languages.title: 5 languages
languages.body: English, Deutsch, Français, Español and Polski for your office team and your drivers.

driverSpot.title: Proof of delivery in your driver's pocket
driverSpot.body: No app store, no training. Drivers open a link, add MatrixFleet to their home screen and get their jobs for the day.
driverSpot.b1: Turn-by-turn navigation via Google Maps or Waze
driverSpot.b2: Signature, photos and notes captured at the door
driverSpot.b3: Daily vehicle walkaround checks with defect reporting
driverSpot.b4: Shift and break logging to support working-time rules

how.title: Live in an afternoon

q1.q: Do my drivers need to download an app?
q1.a: No. The driver app runs in the phone's browser and can be added to the home screen like a normal app on both iPhone and Android. Drivers just open the invitation link.

q2.q: Does MatrixFleet handle VAT for cross-border jobs?
q2.a: Yes. MatrixFleet applies UK VAT, domestic EU VAT or the reverse-charge mechanism depending on where you and your customer are established and whether the customer has a valid VAT number. For GCC companies it applies the local rate (Saudi Arabia 15%, UAE 5%, Bahrain 10%, Oman 5%; no VAT in Qatar and Kuwait) and zero-rates international transport. The correct wording is printed on the invoice. Always confirm unusual cases with your accountant.

q3.a: In a data centre in London, United Kingdom, with nightly encrypted backups. MatrixFleet is designed for UK GDPR and EU GDPR, and the UK benefits from an EU adequacy decision.

q4.q: Do I need GPS trackers in my vehicles?
q4.a: No. Live tracking uses the driver's phone while they are on shift. You can stop location sharing at any time.

q5.q: Can I use it in my language?
q5.a: MatrixFleet is available in English, German, French, Spanish and Polish. Each user chooses their own language.

q6.q: What happens after the free trial?
q6.a: Choose a plan and pay monthly by card. If you don't choose a plan your account is paused — nothing is deleted and you can upgrade later.

q7.a: Yes, at any time. Owners and admins can download a complete export of your company data from Settings → Privacy & data.

q8.a: MatrixFleet is built and operated by Matrix Infotech Ltd, a UK software company.

q9.q: Do you support Saudi Arabia and the other GCC countries?
q9.a: Yes. Companies in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar and Kuwait get their local currency and VAT rules. Saudi companies get bilingual Arabic/English tax invoices with the ZATCA QR code, and can connect to ZATCA (Fatoora) so every invoice is signed, cleared or reported automatically. Corrections are made with credit notes, as ZATCA requires.
